Across validation windows the model ranking is unstable (Kendall tau -0.092), which favours a robust combination.

attempts.rationale: The series has unstable ranking and strong seasonality; a robust weighted combo that adapts to errors is a good first test.
test a robust weighted combo on the full pool using inverse error, to see if including all models improves over pool4.

Try a robust DBA combination on the full pool to see if iterative refinement improves over softmax weights, given unstable ranking and correlated groups.

decision.justification: Selected 'dba' (an agent proposal) as the best of 11 backtested attempts, score 0.9954. Series context: trend strength 1.0 and seasonal strength 1.0; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau -0.092); 5 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 0.949.
